summary: Four bedroom detached home · Available now · Newly decorated throughout · Open plan living room - diner
description:
A spacious four bedroom detached family home in a popular Willington location.

My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the Lettings market this newly refurbished four bedroom house on Larmouth Court, Willington. Nestled away in a quiet corner of the village, the modern build property offers great sized rooms throughout and is newly decorated and carpeted throughout. Briefly comprising; entrance hallway with front facing living room, open plan kitchen-diner with tasteful U-shape kitchen. Utility room with downstairs W.C. Sliding door leading to a West-facing rear garden. Stairs to the first floor landing with access to four double bedrooms - en-suite to master bedroom as well as a good size family bathroom. Externally there both front & rear gardens as well as private driveway and garage.

Providing great access to Durham, Chester-Le-Street and the A1, the house is ideal for a couple or family who desire a modern property in a great County Durham. Available now, unfurnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
